meta.title: Pasporto - Digital Product Passport (DPP), Live Preview
meta.author: WPPoland

steps.code:
<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
delete_transient('_wc_activation_redirect');
update_option('woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array('skipped'=>true, 'completed'=>true));
update_option('woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no');
if (function_exists('wc_get_product_id_by_sku') && class_exists('WC_Product_Simple')) {
  $demo = array(
    array('Organic Cotton Hoodie', '59', array('unique_id'=>'https://id.gs1.org/01/04012345678901', 'passport_url'=>'https://example.org/dpp/04012345678901', 'primary_material'=>'Organic cotton 80%, recycled polyester 20%', 'recycled_percent'=>20, 'carbon_footprint'=>7.4, 'circularity_class'=>'B', 'conformity_doc_url'=>'')),
    array('E-Bike Battery Pack 500 Wh', '429', array('unique_id'=>'https://id.gs1.org/01/04012345678918', 'passport_url'=>'https://example.org/dpp/04012345678918', 'primary_material'=>'Lithium-ion (NMC) cells, aluminium housing', 'recycled_percent'=>12, 'carbon_footprint'=>38.5, 'circularity_class'=>'', 'conformity_doc_url'=>'https://example.org/doc/04012345678918')),
    array('Field Canvas Backpack', '79', array()),
  );
  foreach ($demo as $d) {
    $sku = 'demo-'.sanitize_title($d[0]);
    if (wc_get_product_id_by_sku($sku)) { continue; }
    $p = new WC_Product_Simple();
    $p->set_name($d[0]); $p->set_sku($sku); $p->set_regular_price($d[1]);
    $p->set_status('publish'); $p->set_catalog_visibility('visible');
    if ($d[2]) { $p->update_meta_data('_pasporto_dpp_data', $d[2]); }
    $p->save();
  }
}
